title: Winspace Lún Routte SE 45mm disc brake wheelset
notes: Official product page: 46 mm front and 54 mm rear depth, 21 mm inner width (27.6 mm front, 27.8 mm rear outer), Pillar 1423 spokes 21F/24R for the disc version, steel bearings, Center Lock, 12x100/12x142 mm, 1,710 g pair in black (1,715 g Chameleon) with ±25 g per wheel, tires 25-47 mm, 110 psi maximum, 95 psi maximum for tubeless riding with lower caps for wider tires, and a 120 kg system limit for rider, bike and luggage. US$699 with shipping calculated at checkout from Brazil, US, EU or China warehouses. No bead type, hub model, engagement or mainland China price is published.
